negotiate.quote: "If you want to walk out of here alive, here's what it'll cost."
negotiate.payDesc: "You want to pass? Show me what it's worth to you. Cash, now."
negotiate.cargoDesc: "Leave everything you've got in there — {{cargo}} — and you walk out with your bones intact."
negotiate.favorDesc: They look you up and down, lingering. A crooked smile. "I want a favor. The... personal kind. You know what I mean."
negotiate.weaponDesc: "That weapon. Put it on the ground and step back. I'll let you go."
negotiate.armorDesc: "The armor. Take it off, put it down there. We're even."
negotiate.repDesc: "You swear on your life you'll never set foot here again, and you make it known. Everywhere."

subBossHint: ◆ SUB-BOSS — every hit triggers a precision challenge. Land it to hit hard.
